items.target: Mientras ella esperaba, encontré las llaves.
items.native: While she was waiting, I found the keys.

lessons.speakingPrompt: Use Present e → ie while discussing explain a decision and answer an objection. You and a Spanish-speaking classmate are discussing explain a decision and answer an objection. Change the last stem e to ie in stressed forms; nosotros keeps e. The endings follow the infinitive family. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

items.target: El curso es corto; sin embargo, exige práctica diaria.
items.native: The course is short; however, it requires daily practice.

items.target: Aunque trabajo por la mañana, puedo asistir por la tarde.
items.native: Although I work in the morning, I can attend in the afternoon.

items.target: Las clases son pequeñas, por eso todos participan.
items.native: The classes are small, so everyone participates.

items.target: Además, el centro está cerca de mi casa.
items.native: Also, the center is near my home.

items.target: El precio incluye los materiales, pero no el transporte.
items.native: The price includes the materials, but not transportation.
For these reasons, I decided to enroll.

items.target: Mi hermano pensaba que el curso sería demasiado intenso.
items.native: My brother thought the course would be too intensive.

items.target: Le expliqué que podía elegir un grupo de fin de semana.
items.native: I explained that I could choose a weekend group.

passage.native: My brother thought the course would be too intensive.

passage.target: Le expliqué que podía elegir un grupo de fin de semana.

passage.target: Aunque tendría menos tiempo libre, quería intentarlo.

passage.target: Acepté su consejo y reservé un rato para practicar cada día.
passage.native: I accepted his advice and set aside some time to practice every day.

passage.target: Al terminar el primer mes, revisaré si el plan funciona.
passage.native: At the end of the first month, I will review whether the plan works.
